sql: SELECT * FROM ((SELECT 1 AS g, ev.at::text AS t, ev.kind AS k, left(coalesce(ev.detail, ev.detail_json::text,'-'),220) AS d FROM incentive_collector_events ev WHERE ev.at > now() - interval '60 minutes' AND ev.kind IN ('loop_error','thread_started','thread_stopped','connected','disconnected','reward_residual') ORDER BY ev.at DESC LIMIT 12) UNION ALL (SELECT 2 AS g, max(ev2.at)::text, 'last_'||ev2.kind, count(*)::text FROM incentive_collector_events ev2 WHERE ev2.at > now() - interval '60 minutes' GROUP BY ev2.kind)) u ORDER BY g, t DESC
